Coverage map: instruction.md:1-7 and overview.md:3-9 map to Render, S01 startup/examples/separate saved copy, S02 language dispatch, S21 save/load, Polish organisation/mobile/keyboard and S34 plus Visual themes. behaviour.md:5 maps to S02 fresh JS/HTML and built-in CSS; :7 maps partially to S04 pending cancellation and S03 completed Stop; :9 maps to S09 literal/Promise loops and S36 shared timer budget, with dedicated rollback/recovery; :11 maps to S03 successful delayed click/key/input; :13 maps to S03 Stop preservation and S04/S09-S13/S36 rollback; :15 maps to S10-S13 exact messages and entered-source lines; :19 maps to S14-S16 levels, inspectable values, history, Clear and successful/terminal durations; :21 maps to the four independent S17 outcomes; :25-29 map to S21 identity/fidelity, S23 both-direction revision conflict/refusal/draft/reapply and S24 create/update title controls. integration.md:5,7,9,15 map to the launch/liveness/link harness, Constraints clean-context retrieval and S22 full collection/revision/example inventory/restart-write observations. security.md:3 maps to S05 own-versus-parent document/storage and the cancellation outcomes; :5 maps to S02/S03/S08 ordinary execution and S09/S36 budgets; :7 maps to S08 harmless words and five refused families; :9 maps to S07 controlled fetch/Image; :11 maps to the bounded S21 save/update/load execution canary. ui.md:3-9 maps to S19 editor basics, Functional action rows, Polish control names/reachability/focus/navigation and responsive layout, and S34/Visual theme presentation. These mappings do not erase the following missing lifecycle transitions.

Gap 1 ? cancellation when the replacement mode is HTML or CSS. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/environment/instructions/behaviour.md:5-7 requires all three modes and says "Starting another run cancels whatever the previous one still had pending." .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/environment/instructions/security.md:3 also prohibits replaced work from changing the current preview, console or status. The sole pending-supersession trial in .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:170-179 replaces pending JavaScript A with JavaScript B only; its scored owner at .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:87-91 is explicitly S04 A/B. S02 runs HTML/CSS only after the preceding synchronous run and .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:143 explicitly says not to repeat a CSS-specific timer workflow. There is no criterion observation of a pending callback across replacement by complete HTML or a CSS sample. Hence those mandatory replacement paths can retain late old output without affecting any prescribed observation.

Gap 2 ? error handling after a completed preview receives a later interaction. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/environment/instructions/behaviour.md:11-15 keeps the completed preview interactive until it fails, requires a failed attempt to restore the last successful render, and requires errors to include the message and entered-source line. S03 tests later interactions only with handlers that console.log (.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:149-158), followed by Stop; none throws, rejects or creates a failing callback. All S10-S13 error fixtures originate in the initial Run or callbacks already scheduled by its source (.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:280-355). The descriptors at .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:66-84 and :178-259 therefore never distinguish an app that stops forwarding uncaught errors/rejections and restoring the good render after initial completion. A later-click error can leave failed partial DOM and no useful error message/line while every prescribed S03 and S10-S13 action still succeeds.

Separate inherited-contract limitation, not a newly invented product demand: .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/environment/instructions/integration.md:9,13 and policy.md:7 still require SQLite/better-sqlite3/Express, one local process and no external backend. The frozen template integration.md contains the same architecture contract. Constraints expressly says its browser exchange does not establish SQLite or Express (.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:29; prompt.md:19-21), all judges prohibit implementation inspection, and tests/test.sh:97-111 launches Node with DB_PATH but does not establish the database engine/package/process count or external-backend absence. A Node HTTP implementation with durable JSON can be behaviorally indistinguishable to these observations. Record this as the shared-contract/evidence conflict required by qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md, rather than claim browser proof, silently waive it, change shared policy, or add forbidden source-reading.

Conforming-alternative check: ordinary native controls/dialogs, SSR-delivered library records, a separate clean CSS sandbox, and keeping a candidate hidden behind the last-good render are permitted by the current prompts. The proposed distinguishing lifecycle observations must accept those alternatives and judge actual output/status/error/rollback, not sandbox implementation, visible provisional DOM, live restored handlers, or exact UI labels. No false-fail specific to this coverage row was established. No Docker/provider/judge execution was performed by this reviewer; the source omissions are established, but counterexample app scores are unmeasured. The index expressly lists full configured judge workload, Oracle/Luna and empirical reward ranking as not measured; this row does not turn scripted or source evidence into those measurements.
counterexample: Plausible broken app A: keep otherwise correct JS/HTML/CSS rendering but advance the old-run cancellation token only when the replacement filename is .js. HTML/CSS replace the visible document correctly, yet a previously scheduled JavaScript callback can still append a late log, change status or restore stale DOM. Current S04 always replaces A with .js and S02 has no pending predecessor, so no listed observation catches this. Plausible broken app B: keep console forwarding and successful event handlers alive after initial completion, but disable error/rejection forwarding and rollback when state becomes completed. Initial/timer/Promise failures still work, S03 logging handlers still work, and completed Stop still works; clicking a completed preview button whose handler changes DOM and throws new Error("late-interaction-error") leaves partial DOM without the required message/line/recovery. Both are source-reasoned counterexamples, not executed fixtures or claimed full-score results. Inherited-contract counterexample: preserve all observable API/UI behavior and restart persistence using Node http plus an atomic JSON file instead of Express/better-sqlite3; the current browser-only criteria cannot distinguish it.
suggested_fix: Extend the existing shared cancellation protocol with bounded pending-JS-to-HTML and pending-JS-to-CSS replacements using its already successful callback control, and extend the completed-interaction protocol with a successful interaction followed by an uncaught failure that verifies its own message/source line and last-good restoration as independent outcomes; otherwise narrow the public promises with explicit authorization. Keep shared harness/scoring/budgets unchanged and record the inherited architecture-verification conflict for policy resolution rather than add implementation inspection.
